I'm replacing it with a dark inset panel plus a gold frame, positioning the runes plane just in front so it's visible. I also spot that the finial crescent is drawn edge-on from the front view since its extrude direction faces forward instead of sideways — I need to flip its orientation so it reads correctly from the front.

The floating sparkle orbiters look fine as is, and the shelf 3 books overlap acceptably. For improvements, I'm considering adding roof shingles detail and properly placing the rune panel on the side view instead of leaving it plain, plus maybe a glow halo behind the hanging light — but I should limit myself to just a few targeted edits rather than overhauling everything.

Double-checking the crescent peak and gable height math confirms the proportions line up correctly, and the pillar finials with their gold spikes and glow orbs look right in the front view. I'm now weighing whether to swap the roof's wood-brown color for a deeper indigo shingle texture instead.

Adding dark panel and frame details...
